mapper.sql: id, dict_type, dict_label, dict_value, dict_sort, css_class, is_default, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY dict_sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY dict_sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM sys_dict_data WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dict_data (dict_type, dict_label, dict_value, dict_sort, css_class, is_default, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version) VALUES (#{dictType}, #{dictLabel}, #{dictValue}, COALESCE(#{dictSort}, 0), #{cssClass}, COALESCE(#{isDefault}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 1), #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark}, COALESCE(#{deleted}, 0), COALESCE(#{version}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_data SET deleted = 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} AND deleted = 0
